_readme: S668 SkyPipit, 2026-11-16. Sam's ruling d-both-versions-by-catalog-year-sam-2026-11-15: a plain transfer degree and its 2.0 each keep a record from their own catalog year. This college's plain program reads its 2.0's page in the 2026-2027 catalog. curriQunet's _getCatalogs serves only active catalogs; _getHistoricalCatalogs (heard in run 43794243855 on rccd.curriqunet.com) names the past ones, with the Id an archive view (Catalog/archive/<Id>/iq/...) loads. One load, no model call. sdccd serves San Diego City and Miramar.

questions.prior_catalogs: Which past catalogs the host lists, each with its Id and Title (2025-2026 first, then 2024-2025).
